notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two other creatures with toughness equal to 1.
You have a way to put a -1/-1 counter on a creature.
description:
Put a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to 1. The creatue dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Flourishing Defenses and Host of the Hereafter.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to 1.
Resolve the Flourishing Defenses trigger, creating a 1/1 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
